sync-dev-to-master.yml.name: Sync Dev to Master
sync-dev-to-master.yml.on:
workflow_dispatch:
  inputs:
    operation:
      description: "new creates one new immutable vX.Y.Z tag; sync_only only validates and syncs master."
      required: true
      default: sync_only
      type: choice
      options:
        - sync_only
        - new
    version:
      description: "Required for new. Exact unused tag such as v1.3.1; never an existing version."
      required: false
      type: string
    expected_dev_sha:
      description: "Required full origin/dev SHA approved for this sync."
      required: true
      type: string
